function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies the caller's identity against the account on file, using the last 4 digits of their PAN or their birth year. Must be called and must return verified:true before any debt, loan, or amount details may be disclosed.

account_id.description: The customer's account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

verification_code.description: The last-4-PAN-digits or birth year the caller provided verbally.
